snippet.title: EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS – Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Play EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS when it comes out September 5, 2025 and experience:
🌎 courses from 10 different regions from around the world
🌦️ weather and time changes
🏌️‍♀️ the largest roster of characters in the series
 
AND,
🟡 pre-order and unlock PAC-MAN early!
